title: coreopsis involucrata
intro: Coreopsis involucrata, commonly known as the Rocky Mountain coreopsis, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of anxiety, stress, and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Coreopsis involucrata include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
